_note: Synthetic/illustrative for the prototype demo. Standard VAT rates anchored to real, current values (vatnode/eu-vat-rates-data, MIT licensed, sourced from the EC's TEDB) so a tax-literate reviewer doesn't spot an implausible rate. Reclaim-window and mandatory-field detail reflects real research already in claims.md/case-facts.md, simplified to what the demo needs.

invoice_compliance.note: leistungsdatum (date of supply, distinct from invoice date) is a commonly-missed field per research/tax-domain.md — used here as the demo's format-compliance failure.

reclaim_window.note: Deduction capped at the filing deadline of the annual VAT return for the year the right arose (until the scheduled 1 Jan 2027 reform) — not a rolling count from invoice date. ~4-5 months for a December invoice, ~15-16 months for a January invoice.

invoice_compliance.note: SDI (Sistema di Interscambio) clearance required — a correctly-fielded invoice can still fail on schema/clearance grounds, not just missing fields.
